## Summary

Describe the user/repository outcome and active phase.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when UI behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run format:check`

## Safety and scope

- [ ] Uses synthetic data only
- [ ] No secrets or server credentials reach Git/browser code
- [ ] No spending or Mainnet transaction occurred
- [ ] Documentation/ADR updated where needed
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` updated for handoff
